question: As of December 2021, how many sports infrastructure projects of various categories have been sanctioned in the North Eastern Region under the ‘Khelo India’ scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**62.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**Khelo India Scheme

__
 
• **Flagship Central Sector Scheme** of the** Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports.**
 
• Proposed by the government of India in **2017.**
 
• ​More than** Rs.2400 Crore** allocated under Khelo India Scheme since its inception.
 
• **453 Khelo India Centres **have been notified in** 359 districts of 28 States/UTs** as of date.
 
• **62 sports** infrastructure projects of various categories have been sanctioned in the North Eastern Region **amounting to 423.01 crores.**
 
• The inaugural event was held at **JNL Indoor Stadium.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India program** has been divided into **12 verticals**
